atomic_claims.text: For a,c>=3, symmetrization gives an exact eight-column packing LP with six capacity rows, whose fixed dual polyhedron has exactly nine rational vertices.
On the actual parameter cone, three dual vertices are redundant, so lambda is the maximum of exactly six effective affine rays d0,d3,d5,d6,d7,d8.

The exact face excess is two-thirds the maximum of zero and five explicit obstruction forms R3,R5,R6,R7,R8; this gives a five-inequality full-face characterization equivalent to C28 in the nondegenerate domain.
If min(a,c)<=2, exact complete-split edge decompositions give the ProblemContract form with linear overhead, without applying the fixed quotient outside its valid object types.
If the all-leaf ray d8 is maximal then q>=r-1, and a round-robin actual clique partition has at most lambda+r-1 pieces; hence this cone is root-safe.
